name: awning
note: Shop awning: a tapered canopy with a valance hanging off its front lip. dims = [width, height, projection]. The canopy is a `wedge`, which narrows to 25 % at the top, so it reads as a sloped canopy from the judged iso angle without a second prim. The valance is placed half-overlapping the canopy's front face rather than butted under it: the attach algebra anchors a child's CENTRE along u and its named extreme along v, so a valance anchored exactly at the bottom edge would share zero contact area and V2 would reject the contact it declares.
